text: I, NATE ADAMS, hereby declare that I am a candidate for an elective office in the City of Oakland, and make the following statement, to-wit:
2. The office for which I am a candidate is: City Councilmember District 2
3. My occupation for the past 5 years: Community Organizer
4. I have held the following elected public office (if any): None

5. Statement of General Qualifications: I’ve spent my career fighting for working people. My dedication to our community honors my grandparents—Asian immigrants who made Oakland home—and my mother, a working-class single parent. As your Councilmember, I promise energetic leadership that responds quickly to you and your concerns. After leading an Oakland grassroots organization with 2,400 members, I know how to build consensus and turn shared priorities into action. My experience also includes organizing unions nationwide and helping win Alameda County’s historic ethical investment budgetary policy. I’m making four clear commitments to District 2: safer, cleaner streets; housing families can afford; 1,000 city jobs delivering high-quality services; and actual fiscal accountability. That’s why hundreds of our neighbors—teachers, parents, small business owners, tenants, union members—have knocked thousands of doors for this campaign. I have a proven record of service and accountability, and I’m the only corporate-free candidate in this race. Vote nateforoakland.com

text: I, CHARLENE WANG, hereby declare that I am a candidate for an elective office in the City of Oakland, and make the following statement, to-wit:
2. The office for which I am a candidate is: City Councilmember District 2
3. My occupation for the past 5 years: Policy Advisor
4. I have held the following elected public office (if any): City Council

5. Statement of General Qualifications: Last year, you elected me to put my experience in government reform to work for Oakland. I’m chairing the Public Safety Committee to improve 911, reduce crime, slow reckless driving, and stop illegal dumping. My award-winning work tackling Oakland’s violent sex trade, created California’s first municipal survivor services fund paid through penalties against pimps. I wrote Oakland’s new sanctuary law, banning collection of immigration status data and cooperation with ICE. As a renter, I cut red tape that inflates rent. I’ll keep fighting the affordability crisis. I closed the East 12th encampment, getting people shelter and beautifying the area. I’m converting crime-ridden motels into homeless shelters, bringing Grocery Outlet and 20 businesses to our district, and planning a future BART Station. A safer, cleaner, affordable Oakland is in reach. Mayor Lee, the entire council, and community leaders endorse me because they know I’ll deliver. www.CharleneforOakland.com
